assets.note: No narration-free music was asked for; the effects track (wind, ink drops, seals, the bronze cauldron's hum, hooves, drums, iron, fire, water, cracks, rope, a far chant) is synthesized from code by sfx/make_sound.py in this project from js/cues.js (no recorded or downloaded sound), wrapped with a 16x16 black picture by ffmpeg so js/media.js can play it on the master clock. The user's standing rule: code-synthesized effects, no background music.
